data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Clarify upstream dependencies — this story builds on draft-2 (which creates _errors.py with DirectionMismatchError/UnknownActionError/StatusMappingError AND introduces the 9 named applier leaves with _LEAVES dict + apply() dispatch) and draft-9 (which extends conflict_resolver.py with per-element provenance). _errors.py file impact action is EDIT (file is CREATED by draft-2 task-1; this story edits it to ADD DsoIdLabelWriteError). 9 leaves (outbound_create, outbound_update, outbound_delete, outbound_probe, outbound_conflict, inbound_create, inbound_update, inbound_clean_label, inbound_repair_property) exist post-draft-2. Mutation typed object exists post-draft-1. Docstring-as-contract is intentional and acceptable for this story (no separate docs/ file).
